title: Flux-form spatiotemporal neural operators for coarse-grained dynamics of multiscale PDEs
abstract: arXiv:2608.18148v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study data-driven prediction of coarse-grained dynamics in multiscale PDE systems. Adopting a closure-free operator-learning viewpoint, we apply a linear coarse-graining map and learn a surrogate evolution operator for the resolved field directly from filtered high-fidelity trajectories. Motivated by the Mori-Zwanzig formalism, we propose a spatiotemporal neural operator mapping a resolved history slab on $\Omega\times[-T_{\mathrm{in}},0]$ to a resolved future slab on $\Omega\times[0,T_{\mathrm{out}}]$. Spatial mixing uses Fourier convolution, while temporal mixing uses a causal kernel operator with position-attention weights on time lags. This causal temporal operator encodes finite-memory effects in the resolved dynamics while preserving the directionality of the history-to-future map. translated_title: 多尺度偏微分方程粗粒化动力学的通量形式时空神经算子
translated_abstract: 我们研究了多尺度偏微分方程系统中粗粒化动力学的数据驱动预测。采用无闭合算子学习的视角，我们应用线性粗粒化映射，并直接从过滤后的高保真轨迹中学习解析场的替代演化算子。受Mori-Zwanzig形式主义的启发，我们提出了一种时空神经算子，将$\Omega\times[-T_{\mathrm{in}},0]$上的解析历史片段映射到$\Omega\times[0,T_{\mathrm{out}}]$上的解析未来片段。空间混合使用傅里叶卷积，而时间混合使用带有时间滞后位置注意权重的因果核算子。这种因果时间算子编码了解析动力学中的有限记忆效应，同时保持了历史到未来映射的方向性。为了提高滚动预测的鲁棒性并抑制非保守伪影，我们通过参数化窗口更新嵌入了通量形式的归纳偏置。
tldr: 本文提出了一种通量形式的时空神经算子，通过因果时间核和傅里叶卷积学习多尺度偏微分方程的粗粒化动力学，嵌入通量形式归纳偏置以提高滚动预测的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a flux-form spatiotemporal neural operator that learns coarse-grained dynamics of multiscale PDEs via causal temporal kernels and Fourier convolution, embedding a flux-form inductive bias to enhance rollout robustness.
